svg.title: E-Ticket responsive interface concept
svg.desc: Figma-importable vector design board with public catalog, buyer checkout, admin payment review, and mobile checkout concepts. All content is illustrative; no payment is initiated.

g.text: A coherent, responsive visual system for discovery, checkout and payment operations
Explore tickets, review the price, and track server-confirmed outcomes.
Review your server-priced order before choosing a configured path.
Only methods enabled by the server can start a payment attempt.
A matching recipient must be available
A configured bot must dispatch an invoice
Evidence is not settlement. Wait for
No order, payee or transaction is
Evidence queues and decision context in one place.
A UTR, screenshot, or buyer claim is evidence for review, never proof of settlement.
New evidence will appear here with its server-recorded status.
Payment is final only after server confirmation.
Type: Inter / Segoe UI · 8px spacing grid · 10–18px radii · visible focus and 44px+ controls in implementation
CONCEPT ONLY — no real data, destination, payment initiation or provider confirmation is represented.
